title: Make address required and add zoom controls with location pins to community map

requirements.summary: Make the address field required in the SetCoordinatesDialog component so users cannot submit without providing their address
acceptanceCriteria: Address field in SetCoordinatesDialog has required validation
Form cannot be submitted without an address value
User sees validation feedback if they attempt to submit without an address

file_operations.description: Add required validation to the address input field by setting the 'required' prop on the Input component. Update the form submission handler to prevent submission and show validation feedback when the address field is empty. Add client-side validation that displays an error message if the user attempts to submit without entering an address value.

requirements.summary: Add zoom in and zoom out controls to the GlobeMap component so users can control the camera distance to the globe
acceptanceCriteria: Zoom in button increases camera proximity to globe
Zoom out button decreases camera proximity from globe
Zoom controls are visible and accessible on the GlobeMap
Appropriate min/max zoom limits are enforced

file_operations.description: Add zoom control state and handlers to adjust the camera distance from the globe. Implement zoom in and zoom out functions that smoothly animate the camera position closer to or further from the globe center. Add min/max zoom limits (e.g., minDistance: 3, maxDistance: 10) to prevent users from zooming too close or too far. Use smooth transitions when adjusting camera distance to provide a polished user experience.

Add zoom control UI buttons (zoom in and zoom out) positioned over the GlobeMap component. Create callback props that are passed to the GlobeMap to trigger zoom operations. Position the zoom controls in a fixed location on the map (e.g., bottom-right corner) with clear + and - icons. Ensure the buttons are styled consistently with the app's design system and are accessible with proper ARIA labels.

requirements.summary: Display user locations with visible pin markers on the globe in the GlobeMap component showing where users live based on their addresses
acceptanceCriteria: Pin markers are clearly visible on the globe at user location coordinates
Each pin represents a user's location based on their address
Pins are distinguishable from the globe surface
Pins maintain proper 3D positioning when globe is rotated or zoomed

file_operations.description: Replace or enhance the existing point markers for user locations with 3D pin geometry that is more visible and distinguishable from the globe surface. Create pin meshes using Three.js cone or cylinder geometry with appropriate dimensions (e.g., height 0.3-0.5 units) positioned at each user's coordinates. Apply a distinct color (e.g., bright red or yellow) to the pin material to ensure visibility against both day and night globe textures. Ensure pins are positioned slightly above the globe surface and maintain proper orientation as the globe rotates. Update the raycaster intersection logic to detect pin selections for hover and click interactions.
